title: Canonical ingredient taxonomy and source mappings

stableIdRules.slugPattern: lowercase ASCII letters/digits joined by single hyphens
stableIdRules.governanceRule: Stable IDs are assigned by governed authoring/reconciliation, are immutable after publication, and are never auto-created or auto-merged from display names.
stableIdRules.collisionRule: A lexical or compacted-key collision creates a review candidate only. It never proves identity.

aliasNormalization.punctuation: replace punctuation/separators with spaces except semantically retained apostrophes inside source display text
aliasNormalization.singularPluralRule: singular/plural similarity is candidate discovery only; explicit reconciliation is required

resolvedAliasCandidates.basis: ICF-01 direct cross-source alias candidate; spelling/spacing variant only

canonicalBands.meaning: ordinary baseline scarcity in the authored scope
less frequently encountered or obtained than common in the authored scope
materially scarce in the authored scope
scarcity tier above rare used for source systems such as Alchemy Exotic when Exotic is explicitly a rarity tier
extreme authored scarcity; preserves Cooking Legendary semantics
explicitly singular or effectively singular in the authored scope; never inferred from fame or power

rarity.separationRule: Canonical rarity describes authored baseline scarcity only. It is not nature/origin classification, acquisition availability, identification difficulty, or current market scarcity.
rarity.conflictRule: If provenance-supported rarity assertions conflict, defaultBand remains null and reconciliation.status remains unresolved until a governed resolution records rationale and authority.

availability.rule: Availability describes acquisition/access in an authored scope. MIB-13 market scarcity and current market availability remain economy state and are not stored as ingredient truth.

units.conversionRule: Only explicit exact rational conversions are canonical. Cross-dimension or ingredient-specific conversions require an authored ingredient-specific exact rule. No heuristic conversion is allowed.
units.genericSourceRule: Food Units, Material Units, resource units and bare 'units' are preserved as source-unit assertions and may use unit:source-generic only for reconciliation. They are not sufficient typed outputs for ICF-13 deterministic production.

profileNamespaces.rule: A property belongs to its domain namespace; the same word in two domains does not imply equivalent mechanics.

primaryDerivedBoundary.primaryIngredient: A raw or directly acquired reusable feedstock whose identity does not require an ICF processing transformation lineage.
primaryDerivedBoundary.derivedPreparation: A reusable ingredient-like intermediate intentionally produced from one or more ingredients/preparations through an authored transformation. It uses preparation:<slug> and must retain lineage.
primaryDerivedBoundary.finishedOutput: A finished meal, potion, item, medicine or other product remains the owning item/content kind unless it is explicitly authored as a reusable preparation input.
primaryDerivedBoundary.materialBoundary: A purely structural crafting material with no ICF ingredient role may remain material:<slug>. A biological/magical substance used across culinary/alchemical/medicine/ritual/crafting profiles may be one ingredient definition with those profiles rather than duplicated records.

qualityCondition.rule: Definitions may declare quality/condition rule references and sensitivities, but current quality and current condition belong to the live Asset instance and never create a new ingredient identity by themselves.

substitution.rule: Substitution is an explicit group relation. Name similarity, shared rarity, shared part class or shared effect tags never automatically authorizes substitution.

creatureBoundary.authority: Canonical creature/species definitions own biology and authored loot/harvest references.
creatureBoundary.evidenceRule: A creatureSource profile may cite only authored creature definitions/harvest references. Missing anatomy, edibility, magical effect or harvestability is a coverage gap.

economyBoundary.legacyValueRule: gp, CR, credits, MC and similar legacy values are provenance-scoped sourceValueAssertions. They do not become a global price or exchange rate.
economyBoundary.tradeRule: Ingredient definitions can expose trade/legality classes; actual offers, currencies, route costs, tariffs, scarcity and settlement are versioned MIB-13 economy state.

sourceMappings.rationale: Alchemy explicitly defines Exotic inside its rarity ladder; canonical exceptional preserves tier ordering without equating 'exotic' with a universal nature class.

conflictPolicies.rule: Conflicting mapped rarity assertions do not use source priority by accident. rarity.defaultBand is null until a governed reconciliation decision cites every material assertion and records rationale.
Conflicting legacy values are preserved independently. MIB-13 market state determines current price; ICF never averages or converts legacy currencies without an explicit economy rule.
Lexical/compacted alias collisions create review candidates. Records merge only through explicit identity reconciliation with provenance.
Missing creature anatomy/harvest evidence is represented in coverage.gaps and cannot be filled by generic creature-family assumptions until ICF-07/08/09 authors governed evidence.

crossRecordValidationRules: stableId must be globally unique and immutable after active publication
source-derived and hybrid records must preserve material source assertions; first-party records must cite governed authoring records
aliases may not silently merge two active stable IDs
unresolved conflicting rarity assertions require rarity.defaultBand = null
current market price and market scarcity may not be stored as ingredient truth
sourceValueAssertions must retain original currency term/context and inference status
unit conversion requires explicit rational numerator/denominator; heuristic conversions are forbidden
derived-preparation records require lineage and preparation:<slug>; primary ingredients forbid lineage
current live quality/condition, quantity, owner and custody are forbidden from reusable ingredient definitions
creatureSource evidenceStatus authored/partial requires cited creature or harvest references; gap is valid and preferred to fabrication
substitution requires explicit group membership; shared tags alone are insufficient
setting/reality-specific properties use namespaced extension references rather than redefining canonical domain terms
